-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.TraceSim` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def TraceEv.Ascii (e : TraceEv) : Prop :=
  gsAscii e.name ∧
    gsAscii e.nid ∧
      gsAscii e.vote ∧
        gsAscii e.role ∧
          (∀ (s : GoString), s ∈ e.conf.fst → gsAscii s) ∧
            (∀ (s : GoString), s ∈ e.conf.snd → gsAscii s) ∧
              (∀ (m : TraceMsg), e.msg = some m → gsAscii m.typ ∧ gsAscii m.frm ∧ gsAscii m.to ∧ gsAscii m.vote) ∧
                ∀ (c : TraceCC),
                  e.propCC = some c →
                    (∀ (p : GoString × GoString), p ∈ c.changes → gsAscii p.fst ∧ gsAscii p.snd) ∧
                      ∀ (s : GoString), s ∈ c.newconf → gsAscii s

def TraceSim.entAbs (C : List w64) (bl k : Nat) (e : EntryM) : Etcdraft.Entry :=
  if k ≤ bl then
    { term := 1, type := Etcdraft.EntryType.config, value := Etcdraft.Value.conf (TraceSim.confAbs (List.take k C)) [] }
  else { term := uint.Z e.Term', type := Etcdraft.EntryType.value, value := Etcdraft.Value.val 0 }

def TraceSim.evConv (e : TraceEv) : Etcdraft.Event :=
  { name := TraceSim.gsStr e.name, nid := TraceSim.gsStr e.nid,
    state := { term := TraceSim.gInt e.term, vote := TraceSim.gsStr e.vote, commit := TraceSim.gInt e.commit },
    role := TraceSim.gsStr e.role, log := TraceSim.gInt e.logSize,
    conf := (List.map TraceSim.gsStr e.conf.fst, List.map TraceSim.gsStr e.conf.snd),
    msg :=
      Option.map
        (fun m =>
          { type := TraceSim.gsStr m.typ, term := TraceSim.gInt m.term, «from» := TraceSim.gsStr m.frm,
            to := TraceSim.gsStr m.to, entries := TraceSim.gInt m.entries, logTerm := TraceSim.gInt m.logTerm,
            index := TraceSim.gInt m.index, commit := TraceSim.gInt m.commit, vote := TraceSim.gsStr m.vote,
            reject := m.reject, rejectHint := TraceSim.gInt m.rejectHint })
        e.msg,
    prop :=
      if (e.propCC.isNone && e.propMatch.isNone && e.propNext.isNone) = true then none
      else some { cc := Option.map TraceSim.ccConv e.propCC } }

def gsAscii (b : GoString) : Prop :=
  ∀ (c : w8), c ∈ b → BitVec.toNat c < 128

def TraceSim.ccConv (c : TraceCC) : Etcdraft.EventConfChange :=
  {
    changes :=
      if c.changes.isEmpty = true then none
      else some (List.map (fun p => { nid := TraceSim.gsStr p.fst, action := TraceSim.gsStr p.snd }) c.changes),
    newconf := if c.newconf.isEmpty = true then none else some (List.map TraceSim.gsStr c.newconf) }

def TraceSim.msgAbs (C : List w64) (bl : Nat) (m : Msg) : Option Etcdraft.Msg :=
  have base := fun t =>
    { type := t, term := uint.Z m.term, source := TraceSim.idAbs m.src, dest := TraceSim.idAbs m.dst };
  match m.ty with
  | MsgType.vote =>
    have b := base Etcdraft.MsgType.requestVoteRequest;
    some
      { type := b.type, subtype := b.subtype, term := b.term, lastLogTerm := uint.Z m.logterm,
        lastLogIndex := uint.Z m.index, voteGranted := b.voteGranted, prevLogIndex := b.prevLogIndex,
        prevLogTerm := b.prevLogTerm, entries := b.entries, commitIndex := b.commitIndex, success := b.success,
        matchIndex := b.matchIndex, source := b.source, dest := b.dest }
  | MsgType.voteResp =>
    have b := base Etcdraft.MsgType.requestVoteResponse;
    some
      { type := b.type, subtype := b.subtype, term := b.term, lastLogTerm := b.lastLogTerm,
        lastLogIndex := b.lastLogIndex, voteGranted := !m.reject, prevLogIndex := b.prevLogIndex,
        prevLogTerm := b.prevLogTerm, entries := b.entries, commitIndex := b.commitIndex, success := b.success,
        matchIndex := b.matchIndex, source := b.source, dest := b.dest }
  | MsgType.app =>
    have b := base Etcdraft.MsgType.appendEntriesRequest;
    some
      { type := b.type, subtype := "app", term := b.term, lastLogTerm := b.lastLogTerm, lastLogIndex := b.lastLogIndex,
        voteGranted := b.voteGranted, prevLogIndex := uint.Z m.index, prevLogTerm := uint.Z m.logterm,
        entries := TraceSim.logAbs C bl (uint.nat m.index + 1) m.entries, commitIndex := uint.Z m.commit,
        success := b.success, matchIndex := b.matchIndex, source := b.source, dest := b.dest }
  | MsgType.heartbeat =>
    have b := base Etcdraft.MsgType.appendEntriesRequest;
    some
      { type := b.type, subtype := "heartbeat", term := b.term, lastLogTerm := b.lastLogTerm,
        lastLogIndex := b.lastLogIndex, voteGranted := b.voteGranted, prevLogIndex := b.prevLogIndex,
        prevLogTerm := b.prevLogTerm, entries := b.entries, commitIndex := uint.Z m.commit, success := b.success,
        matchIndex := b.matchIndex, source := b.source, dest := b.dest }
  | MsgType.appResp =>
    have b := base Etcdraft.MsgType.appendEntriesResponse;
    some
      { type := b.type, subtype := "app", term := b.term, lastLogTerm := b.lastLogTerm, lastLogIndex := b.lastLogIndex,
        voteGranted := b.voteGranted, prevLogIndex := b.prevLogIndex, prevLogTerm := b.prevLogTerm, entries := b.entries,
        commitIndex := b.commitIndex, success := !m.reject, matchIndex := if m.reject = true then 0 else uint.Z m.index,
        source := b.source, dest := b.dest }
  | MsgType.heartbeatResp =>
    have b := base Etcdraft.MsgType.appendEntriesResponse;
    some
      { type := b.type, subtype := "heartbeat", term := b.term, lastLogTerm := b.lastLogTerm,
        lastLogIndex := b.lastLogIndex, voteGranted := b.voteGranted, prevLogIndex := b.prevLogIndex,
        prevLogTerm := b.prevLogTerm, entries := b.entries, commitIndex := b.commitIndex, success := true,
        matchIndex := b.matchIndex, source := b.source, dest := b.dest }
  | x => none

def TraceSim.gsStr (b : GoString) : String :=
  String.mk (List.map (fun c => Char.ofNat (BitVec.toNat c)) b)

def TraceSim.gInt (w : w64) : Int :=
  sint.Z w

def TraceSim.SimServerR (C : List w64) (bl : Nat) (s : PState) (a : Etcdraft.Server) : Prop :=
  a.currentTerm = uint.Z s.term ∧
    a.state = TraceSim.roleAbs s.role ∧
      a.votedFor = TraceSim.idAbs s.vote ∧
        a.lead = TraceSim.idAbs s.lead ∧
          uint.Z s.base.index' = 0 ∧
            a.log = TraceSim.logAbs C bl 1 s.log ∧
              a.commitIndex = uint.Z s.commit ∧
                a.config = { incoming := TraceSim.confAbs C, outgoing := [], learners := [] } ∧
                  a.pendingConfChangeIndex = 0 ∧
                    (s.role = Role.candidate →
                        a.votesResponded = Etcdraft.SetIds.mk (List.map (fun p => TraceSim.idAbs p.fst) s.votes.toList) ∧
                          a.votesGranted =
                            Etcdraft.SetIds.mk
                              (List.map (fun p => TraceSim.idAbs p.fst) (List.filter (fun p => p.snd) s.votes.toList))) ∧
                      (s.role = Role.leader →
                        ∀ (j : w64), j ∈ C → a.matchIndex (TraceSim.idAbs j) = uint.Z ((s.matched !! j).getD (W64 0)))

def TraceSim.confAbs (C : List w64) : Etcdraft.SetIds :=
  Etcdraft.SetIds.mk (List.map TraceSim.idAbs C)

def TraceSim.idAbs (w : w64) : Etcdraft.ID :=
  uint.nat w

def TraceSim.roleAbs : Role → Etcdraft.Role :=
  match x✝ with
  | Role.follower => Etcdraft.follower
  | Role.candidate => Etcdraft.candidate
  | Role.leader => Etcdraft.leader

def TraceSim.logAbs (C : List w64) (bl first : Nat) (l : List EntryM) : List Etcdraft.Entry :=
  List.mapIdx (fun k e => TraceSim.entAbs C bl (first + k) e) l
